github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text:
Strictly follow Conventional Commits (@commitlint/config-conventional):
1. Line 1 (Header): '<type>(<scope>): <concise subject>' in lowercase imperative mood without trailing period. Keep header to minimum length (strictly under 72 characters, never exceed 100).
2. Line 2: Empty blank line.
3. Line 3+ (Body): Detailed description explaining what and why, wrapped at 72 characters.

Example format:
feat(terminal): add Monaco and Micro diff editor options

Implement modular configuration storage and introduce Monaco/Micro diff
editor options with corresponding settings and UI components.

Never add AI co-author or attribution trailers (e.g. Co-authored-by: Cursor/Copilot).
